Allow: /

# Authenticated / transactional pages — no SEO value, must not be indexed
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /oauth
Disallow: /guest
Disallow: /basket
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /post-order
Disallow: /pre-order
Disallow: /orders
Disallow: /tracking
Disallow: /address
Disallow: /payment-methods
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /activate
Disallow: /engagement

# Subscription management — private, behind auth
Disallow: /pro-hub

# Internal API routes
Disallow: /api

# Dynamic landing pages — campaign-specific, not stable SEO targets
Disallow: /dynamic-landings

# Block internal search results (INI-11376, Winclap audit point 7)
# Infinite query variations waste crawl budget and produce thin content. The whole path, as the agency asked:
# /search?q=* missed /search?store-type=…&store-id=… and the legacy /search?query=… URLs
Disallow: /search

# Googlebot-image: allow image crawling across the entire site
User-agent: Googlebot-image
Allow: /
